metadata.description: Marketplace hosting the autoNod and usage-line plugins.

plugins.name: autonod
plugins.description: Frictionless-but-safe auto-approval for Claude Code. Auto-approves safe frontend edits; hard-denies .env, secrets, backend URLs, and network egress in every permission mode.

plugins.name: usage-line
plugins.description: Always-on status line showing model, context window %, session cost, and 5h/7d rate-limit usage. Configures itself automatically on first run — no settings.json editing required.
